posts.title: PreDemo 1.5: the road to the next playtest
posts.excerpt: What lands in the PreDemo 1.5 build: PR smoke-test CI, a rebuilt world generator, AI pathfinding, a headless server and the grenade launcher.

posts.title: World generation, rebuilt: from OpenSimplex2 to FastNoise2
posts.excerpt: Ecliptica's terrain generator switches to FastNoise2 - SIMD (AVX2) batch generation, deterministic output across platforms, and a cross-platform test suite.

posts.title: Multiplayer foundations: EclipticaServer and the headless ServerWorld
posts.excerpt: The first step toward co-op: a dedicated EclipticaServer binary that runs the world headless - no renderer, no input, just the simulation.

posts.title: Demo 1.0 progress: the grenade launcher
posts.excerpt: A new tool for Demo 1.0: the grenade launcher - small bombs with a two-second fuse, manual and automatic fire modes, and bombs that detonate on damage.
